Gideon closed ticket #8841 with support on 1 Jul, per his 09:17 post in #strategic-pod. The fix was that Vantorre's IT cleared a browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets, after which the standard template worked for their billing team. I replied in the thread under your question.

A 30 Sep digest in the brain describes #8841 differently (a Dock Door 14 kiosk selection problem escalated to platform engineering), so the ticket record itself should be checked.
